evaluation_components.notes: Closed Book, Each quiz will be of 15 marks. Total 6 quizzes will be conducted out of which best 4 will be considered for grading. 50% quizzes will be surprise.
Open Book, Class Participation: This component evaluates student engagement during lecture hours. This is also linked with the attendance in the lecture class.

attendance_policy: Each student is expected to attend all classes and participate in all evaluation components.
makeup_policy: Make-up for mid-sem and comprehensive examination will be considered ONLY in genuine cases (accompanied by proof). (NOTE: no make-up will be given for quizzes and class participation).
